design_notes: Unvalidated research hypotheses: equal weights combine normalized foreground CE, boundary error and adjacent false-positive probability. EMA alpha 0.25 and age 25 epochs favor recent actual measurements; 20% exploration and 20% easy retention preserve coverage and easy examples. The remaining 60% follows measured/predicted error quantiles across five 50-epoch stages. Fixed compatibility-score gap 2.0 is a separate train-only quality gate, not a difficulty label or medical validity guarantee. Predictions are optional to this standalone policy but the Full trainer separately requires an independently trained feedback GNN configuration; absent or stale estimates remain explicit exploration. Tune only on training-side evidence before held-out evaluation.
